description:
Title: Building a custom machine out of Lego bricks

When building a custom machine out of Lego bricks, you first need to develop the basic design.
After that, you order certain Lego brick sets.
You give the lego sets to a group of children which should sort the parts for you (into a number of containers).
Your machine is built out of a number of subcomponents.
You build them individually, using parts from the sorted containers.
If there are no more parts in a container, you reorder individual parts.
After building each subcomponent, you have to test them individually and (if each test is successful) assemble them.
If subcomponents are not tested successfully, you have to redesign and rebuild them.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_CustomMachine"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/custom-machine">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_BuildCustomMachine" name="Building a custom machine out of Lego bricks" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Main">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Builder" name="Builder">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Building</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DevelopDesign</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_OrderSets</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GiveSetsToChildren</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SubProcess_BuildAndTestSubcomponents</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssembleSubcomponents</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_MachineAssembled</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Children" name="Group of children">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SortParts</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Building" name="Begin building custom machine">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Design</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DevelopDesign" name="Develop basic design">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Design</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Design_Order</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderSets" name="Order Lego brick sets">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Design_Order</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Order_Give</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GiveSetsToChildren" name="Give Lego sets to children">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Order_Give</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Give_Sort</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SortParts" name="Sort parts into containers">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Give_Sort</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Sort_SubProcess</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_BuildAndTestSubcomponents" name="Build and test each subcomponent">
      <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Subcomponents">
        <bpmn:lane id="Lane_SubcomponentBuilder" name="Builder">
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Subcomponent</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PartsAvailable</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReorderParts</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PartsMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_BuildSubcomponent</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TestSubcomponent</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TestResult</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RedesignSubcomponent</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_SubcomponentTested</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        </bpmn:lane>
      </bpmn:laneSet>

      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Subcomponent" name="Begin one subcomponent">
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Sub_Start_PartsGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PartsAvailable" name="Are parts available?" default="Flow_PartsAvailable_Build">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Sub_Start_PartsGateway</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Redesign_PartsGateway</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PartsMissing_Reorder</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PartsAvailable_Build</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ReorderParts" name="Reorder individual parts">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PartsMissing_Reorder</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Reorder_PartsMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PartsMerge" name="Merge parts paths">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Reorder_PartsMerge</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PartsAvailable_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PartsMerge_Build</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_BuildSubcomponent" name="Build subcomponent using sorted parts">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PartsMerge_Build</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Build_Test</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_TestSubcomponent" name="Test subcomponent">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Build_Test</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Test_Result</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TestResult" name="Was the subcomponent test successful?" default="Flow_TestFailed_Redesign">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Test_Result</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TestPassed_End</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TestFailed_Redesign</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_RedesignSubcomponent" name="Redesign subcomponent">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TestFailed_Redesign</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Redesign_PartsGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_SubcomponentTested" name="Subcomponent test successful">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TestPassed_End</bpmn:incoming>
      </bpmn:endEvent>

      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Sub_Start_PartsGateway" sourceRef="StartEvent_Subcomponent" targetRef="Gateway_PartsAvailable"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PartsMissing_Reorder" name="No more parts in a container" sourceRef="Gateway_PartsAvailable" targetRef="Task_ReorderParts">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">noMorePartsInAContainer</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PartsAvailable_Build" name="Parts available" sourceRef="Gateway_PartsAvailable" targetRef="Gateway_PartsMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reorder_PartsMerge" sourceRef="Task_ReorderParts" targetRef="Gateway_PartsMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PartsAvailable_Merge" sourceRef="Gateway_PartsAvailable" targetRef="Gateway_PartsMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PartsMerge_Build" sourceRef="Gateway_PartsMerge" targetRef="Task_BuildSubcomponent"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Build_Test" sourceRef="Task_BuildSubcomponent" targetRef="Task_TestSubcomponent"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Test_Result" sourceRef="Task_TestSubcomponent" targetRef="Gateway_TestResult"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TestPassed_End" name="Test successful" sourceRef="Gateway_TestResult" targetRef="EndEvent_SubcomponentTested">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">testSuccessful</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TestFailed_Redesign" name="Test unsuccessful" sourceRef="Gateway_TestResult" targetRef="Task_RedesignSubcomponent"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Redesign_PartsGateway" sourceRef="Task_RedesignSubcomponent" targetRef="Gateway_PartsAvailable"/>

      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="true">
        <bpmn:loopCardinality xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">numberOfSubcomponents</bpmn:loopCardinality>
      </bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssembleSubcomponents" name="Assemble subcomponents">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SubProcess_Assemble</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Assemble_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_MachineAssembled" name="Custom machine assembled">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Assemble_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Design" sourceRef="StartEvent_Building" targetRef="Task_DevelopDesign"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Design_Order" sourceRef="Task_DevelopDesign" targetRef="Task_OrderSets"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Order_Give" sourceRef="Task_OrderSets" targetRef="Task_GiveSetsToChildren"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Give_Sort" sourceRef="Task_GiveSetsToChildren" targetRef="Task_SortParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Sort_SubProcess" sourceRef="Task_SortParts" targetRef="SubProcess_BuildAndTestSubcomponents"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubProcess_Assemble" sourceRef="SubProcess_BuildAndTestSubcomponents" targetRef="Task_AssembleSubcomponents"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Assemble_End" sourceRef="Task_AssembleSubcomponents" targetRef="EndEvent_MachineAssembled"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
